features.submission_batching: implemented, rejected by five-pair performance comparison; disabled

measurement_scope: Fresh-worker recursive aggregation of retained wallet proofs, including root promotion. Each arm warmed once per size, then five alternating measured repetitions. Wallet generation, native/durable application, and separate CPU audits excluded. Rates are aggregation equivalents, not sustained end-to-end transaction throughput.

cuda_comparison.rule: At least 2% lower median proof interval on an improving workload with >=80% paired wins; no workload median regression over 2% in either proof interval or launcher time.
cuda_comparison.scope: Aggregation of retained wallet proofs; wallet generation, durable application and separate CPU audits excluded.

opencl_comparison.rule: At least 2% lower median proof interval on an improving workload with >=80% paired wins; no workload median regression over 2% in either proof interval or launcher time.
opencl_comparison.scope: Aggregation of retained wallet proofs; wallet generation, durable application and separate CPU audits excluded.

validation.source_integration: same runtime source on main, with verified rustfmt-equivalent changes in two Rust files; benchmark memory reporting corrected separately from saved logs; shared-worker Nsight Compute exec tracing fixed and independently exercised afterward; compressed Nsight Compute report support added with 58 focused Python checks and two fully CPU-audited captures after host profiling access was enabled
validation.final_checks: Rust formatting, Python syntax, diff whitespace, source fidelity and all reported managed-memory peaks within the original 7 GiB limit passed. After the Nsight format fix, source hashes, evidence hashes, Python syntax, diff whitespace, instrumented-result exclusion, independent proof/root audits and worker retirement were checked again; all passed.

report_format_fix_checks.scope: Two new report-format regression tests plus reruns of the affected profiling and shared-launch suites. Other Python checks retain prior evidence; no CUDA runtime source changed.

analysis.interpretation: Instrumented diagnostics only. API waits overlap GPU work; host ranges nest. Neither may be added to kernel time or treated as removable overhead. Kernel-active time excludes transfers and memory initialization.

provenance.scope: Diagnostic before/after profiles. Performance qualification uses the separately rebuilt, matched-source uninstrumented campaign.

captures.scope: One representative NTT launch; software instruction metrics only. Instrumented timings are excluded from throughput comparisons.

nsight_compute.worker_handoff_fix: Shared-worker captures follow the exec handoff within the assigned cgroup.
nsight_compute.report_format_fix: Accept one non-empty .ncu-rep or .ncu-repz capture; reject missing, empty, non-file and ambiguous reports.
nsight_compute.scope: Two diagnostic launches on the optimized RTX 5080 candidate. Instrumented runs are excluded from all throughput comparisons; no baseline hardware-counter comparison claimed.

rejected_submission_candidate.rule: At least 2% lower median proof interval on an improving workload with >=80% paired wins; no workload median regression over 2% in either proof interval or launcher time.
rejected_submission_candidate.scope: Aggregation of retained wallet proofs; wallet generation, durable application and separate CPU audits excluded.

build_memory: Initial 3 GiB build attempt hit its memory limit; successful builds used 8 GiB. GPU worker/benchmark budgets were unchanged.
limits: Only RTX 5080 desktop execution qualified; V100 has compile coverage only.
